protocol.calibration_status: UNCALIBRATED: every threshold and cap below is an upstream default or an author choice. None was fitted to data, none is validated, none is a recommendation. See docs/PROTOCOL.md.

read_first.label: public_dataset_negative
read_first.statement: On the locked NASA SMAP/MSL protocol, OES32 did not meet its pre-stated success criterion: it beat only EWMA on SMAP, and maxabs and CUSUM scored a higher pooled F1 (not significantly).

read_first.label: synthetic_negative
read_first.statement: On the oes-telemetry-bench SYNTHETIC held-out set, max-abs matched OES32's detections (6/7 each) with fewer false-alarm episodes per normal hour (11.54 vs 23.08); the rates come from about 5 minutes of synthetic normal time and are highly uncertain.

read_first.label: synthetic_negative
read_first.statement: The multi-quantum-oes preregistered SYNTHETIC stress evaluation found no demonstrated advantage: the block score did not beat a simple max-abs baseline.

read_first.label: unrun
read_first.statement: oes32-hls FPGA synthesis is UNRUN; its latency figure is a design target, not a measurement.

read_first.label: unrun
read_first.statement: The qldpc_decoder_cpp HLS kernel has no belief-propagation updates yet; its HLS synthesis and hardware-in-the-loop runs are UNRUN.
